rationale: The agent verified the user via matching email, accessed only the authenticated user’s data, and provided recent order details using read-only tools. The user explicitly requested to return the Gaming Mouse and to refund via PayPal. Before making any changes, the agent restated the exact action (returning the Gaming Mouse from order #W7387996 with refund to PayPal) and obtained explicit confirmation. The agent then executed the return using the correct tool with the correct order ID, item ID, and payment method ID. The tool response showed the order status updated to “return requested,” and the agent conveyed accurate final information (refund to PayPal upon processing and email with return instructions). No unsupported claims, no actions without confirmation, and no cross-account actions occurred. The conversation meets the policy requirements.
